description.value: Rongsi Thai Bar & Bistro is an elevated Thai restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street corridor, drawing inspiration from the cultural significance of rice in traditional Thai communities. The kitchen blends comforting Thai classics with modern creativity, using fresh local ingredients across a menu spanning appetizers, salads, soups, and a full cocktail and wine program. It is a full sit-down dining destination with a warm, welcoming atmosphere suited to a post-ride meal.
